### Day 7: 1 Samuel 2:12–26
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-7-1-samuel-2-1226.html
Passage: 1 Samuel 2:12-26
Points:
- Eli's corrupt sons abused priestly authority and showed total disregard for the Lord.
- God displayed grace to Eli by giving him an opportunity to mentor young Samuel.
- The failures of spiritual leaders do not give us an excuse to compromise our faith.
- God's voice grew rare because unfaithful leaders refused to listen to and honor Him.
- Hannah provided lasting influence by teaching Samuel to depend completely on God.
